faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes-AMG SL55 use?
faqLeft.a: The R232-generation SL55 uses the M177 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8, fitted from 2021 onwards.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-AMG SL55 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £6,500. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SL55?
faqLeft.a: The R232 SL55 uses the M177. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M177 SL55 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn valve seals and coolant components as standard on every M177 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you supply used SL55 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SL55 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SL55 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SL55 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

faqRight.q: Is the R232 SL55 the same as the older SL55?
faqRight.a: No — the older R230 SL55 used a supercharged 5.4-litre V8 (M113). The R232 SL55 uses a completely different twin-turbo 4.0-litre V8 (M177). They share a name but are entirely different engines.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
